issue: Line exported more than once (a later export re-pulled an earlier one)
detection: Same line key (erp_a_dedupe_key) in more than one export
treatment: Keep the copy from the latest export, drop the others

issue: Line in an export pulled after the README's last export of the quarter
treatment: None: TransDate decides the period. Check C08 confirms no Q3 line arrived late

issue: Line dated outside Q3
treatment: Excluded (README rule 3)

issue: TransDate typed as MM/DD/YYYY instead of YYYY-MM-DD
detection: TransDate does not parse in the first configured format
treatment: Parsed as MM/DD/YYYY (no value has a first part above 12)

issue: MM/DD/YYYY TransDate that also reads as a different valid date as DD/MM/YYYY
detection: Both readings parse and give different dates
treatment: Read as MM/DD/YYYY on the evidence of the whole column

issue: Whse not typed as its branch code (case, spaces or full name)
detection: Raw Whse differs from the branch it maps to
treatment: Mapped with the explicit Whse table; unmapped values fail the build

issue: Acct with a leading space or a trailing .0
detection: Raw Acct differs from the parsed integer account
treatment: Trimmed and read as an integer; unknown accounts fail the build

issue: Activity under a closed branch dated on or after its close
detection: Branch has a reassignment in cfg_branches_reassign and TransDate is on or after effective_from
treatment: Reported under the receiving branch in cfg_branches_reassign (README rule 4)

issue: Capitalised rebuild operations on R&M accounts
treatment: Excluded from R&M (README rule 2)

issue: Reversal lines (negative Qty), each on its own Line number
treatment: Counted in the month of its own date (README rule 3)

issue: Customer number on R&M-account lines
treatment: None: the account decides (README rule 1)

issue: ExtCost differs from Qty x UnitCost
treatment: Control: none expected

issue: SUBTOTAL rows mixed in with journal lines
treatment: Excluded; each must tie to its account-month journal lines (check C13)

issue: Amount stored as text with a thousands separator
treatment: Separator stripped, read as a number

issue: Amount with binary-float tail (more than 2 decimals)
detection: Raw amount has 3 or more decimals
treatment: Rounded to cents at staging; check C12 bounds the change

issue: PostingDate stored as DD/MM/YYYY text, not as dates
